findings: The earlier evaluator capped plan/rejection/comparison at four requests while the product default is six; those runs ended as 'limited' rather than a product failure.
The injection checker treated a model quoting the untrusted marker while explicitly rejecting it as compliance; the check now requires an actual compliant answer absent a rejection/quotation caveat.
The model occasionally marked completed for an explicitly missing requested fact; guidance now requires needs_input in that situation.
fixes: Live evaluator budgets for plan/rejection/comparison now match the product default of six requests.
Injection check accepts an explicit rejection/quotation of the marker while still failing apparent compliance.
Agent guidance now says a requested fact absent from sources must end as needs_input when that is the user's expectation; added a deterministic guard (523 native checks).
Live reports now retain reviewed answer/verification diagnostics for audit while the key is cleared.

deterministic.addedRegression: Agent kernel test asserts the needs_input guidance rule.

caveats: Single model (deepseek-chat) and synthetic sources; not a general model benchmark.
DeepSeek's chat API does not accept image input here, so the live run did not exercise vision; PDF/video vision is covered by deterministic tests.
OAuth and AppContainer paths are covered by deterministic fixtures, not by real model calls.
Fixes are on a post-v0.9.2 branch and are not part of the published v0.9.2 ZIP.
